mapper.select: SELECT notification_id AS id, notification_type AS notificationType, expiration_status AS expirationStatus, title, content, is_read AS `read`, created_at AS createdAt FROM notifications WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, notification_id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE notifications SET is_read = TRUE WHERE notification_id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE notifications SET is_read = TRUE WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_read = FALSE
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM notifications WHERE notification_id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
